projection: equirectangular, north up, east to the right; lon 0 at the centre
normal: tangent space x=east y=north z=up, IMAGE-DERIVED (no global DEM): band-pass luminance (6 px at 8k) as height, bright = high, RMS slope 5 deg where the mosaic is sharp (x Q), x 0.7 in filled areas
colour: the mosaic's own colour, saturation x0.85; harsh terminator lighting soft-clamped to the local median; low-resolution areas de-ringed; gaps filled (wavy ramp <= 128 px, ring inpaint); polar caps de-rippled in an azimuthal grid; multiplicative sphere-noise grain (0.6 x local detail); luminance mean of the previous map (tone power 1.000); no blue cast; low-resolution areas carry band-pass detail of Io's own sharp terrain through 5 sphere rotations, weight (1-Q)
source: USGS Astrogeology: Io Galileo SSI / Voyager Global Mosaic ClrMerge 1 km
